$comment: Written by HABLO-installer to <firstmate>/config/crew-dispatch.json. Every crewmate and scout is a Pi session on bedrouter's auto model, so model tiering is bedrouter's decision (per request, with escalation) rather than the dispatcher's. __MODEL__ is replaced with bedrouter/<ladder auto alias>.

rules.when: Any task: implementation, fixes, refactors, tests, documentation, investigation, review, scouting.
rules.why: HABLO routes every request through bedrouter, which classifies each request (trivial / execute / explore), picks the cheapest adequate Bedrock model, sticks per conversation, and escalates on failure. Do not pin other models or harnesses; the router's decision log is the cost record for the whole crew.

rules.when: The captain explicitly asks for a specific tier, e.g. 'use the strongest model' or 'cheap pass only'.
rules.why: Even then stay on bedrouter: raise effort (thinking) rather than pinning a model; bedrouter treats high effort as an explore signal and routes up.
